top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no documentation of fire safety emergency drills, fire extinguisher checks, smoke detector checks, and carbon monoxide detector testing made available for review during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §744.501(17))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The parent hand book/ operational policies did not have policies for parents rights available for review during the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.

top_violation_types.title: Maintain Menus (26 TAC §747.3113(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A menu was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detector was not working and there was not a smoke detector in the front room.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 12 children did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §747.301(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to notify licensing of field trip services having been offered.     This was corrected at inspection after primary caregiver informed she will no longer be doing field trips.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion for indoor/outdoor promotion was not included in the parent handbook.
